verdict.rationale: Godot's full engine source is public on GitHub under the permissive MIT license. The license explicitly allows distributing modified versions. The repo points to official compilation instructions for every supported platform, so developers can rebuild a modified engine. Community members describe reading the engine code directly (e.g., critiquing the pathfinding implementation) and contributing PRs that core maintainers actively review. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the build-from-source workflow itself (the pack only points to the compilation docs) and a hands-on account of modifying and rebuilding the engine to get past a limitation.
